headline: Shell Commits $210 Million for Oil Exploration Off Newfoundland
summary: Shell secured six new licences and pledged more than $210 million for oil exploration off the Newfoundland coast following a provincial regulator auction.
why: Long-term exploration commitments by major energy firms indicate ongoing capital allocation toward offshore fossil fuel assets despite broader energy transition trends.
